svg.aria-label: How a generalised additive model builds a curve. Pieces: the input's range is covered by seven short smooth bumps that overlap. Added up: each bump is scaled by a weight, and the weighted bumps add up to a curve that follows the data's rise and fall. Penalty: each bend costs; with bends cheap the curve chases the noise, with bends dear it becomes a straight line, and the data set the price in between. A note says the effective degrees of freedom count the bends the penalty leaves: 1 is a straight line.
svg.text: How a GAM builds a curve
its weight, and the sum is
a curve of almost any shape.
The effective degrees of freedom count the bends the penalty leaves: 1 is a straight line.
